gr_list.description: Integrations service core + HB API mock (port 7106). Yeni mikro servis iskeleti, integration_accounts CRUD, orders_cache, mock marketplace providers.
Kargo entegrasyonu mock. ICargoProvider interface + mock implementations (Aras, Yurtici). Kargo durumu query + proaktif mesaj trigger.
Outbound Engine v2. Campaign CRUD, A/B testing, conversion tracking, AI personalization (Knowledge), time-based triggers, ROI stats endpoints.
Opt-in toplama framework. consent_records tablosu, ConsentManager, opt-in check before outbound, WA + webhook opt-in collection, STOP keyword consent_records sync.
Compliance temel (delta on GR-2.6). Template audit trail, veri silme API, saklama suresi config, TC/telefon maskeleme.

plan.summary: PKT-5A Platform Altyapi: Yeni Invekto.Integrations servisi (port 7106, mock HB + kargo), Outbound v2 (campaign, A/B test, conversion tracking, AI personalization), Opt-in Framework (consent_records, pre-send consent check), Compliance delta (audit trail, data deletion, masking). 5 GR, 26 alt madde.
plan.interview_notes: Tur 1: (1) PKT-5 10 GR -> PKT-5A+5B olarak bolundu. (2) HB/Kargo API erisimi yok -> mock/interface pattern. (3) Google Calendar OAuth hazir degil -> mock ile basla. (4) SLA: Main App webhook ile beslenecek. Tur 2: (1) 5A=altyapi, 5B=genisleme dagitimi onaylandi. (2) Knowledge Service deploy edilmis -> AI personalization baglayabiliriz. (3) Opt-in: Main App webhook + WA mesaji ile toplanacak. (4) Compliance: GR-2.6 delta -> veri silme, saklama, maskeleme, audit trail.

verification_questions.question: Does every DB query in IntegrationsRepository and OutboundRepository include tenant_id WHERE clause for multi-tenant isolation?
Does ConsentManager check consent_records before every outbound message (broadcast + trigger), blocking unconsented marketing messages?
Does the Integrations service properly validate JWT tokens and reject requests with tenant_id mismatch?
Are 3rd party API credentials (api_key_encrypted) never logged or exposed in error responses?
Does OrderSyncService handle connection failures, timeouts, and provider errors gracefully with typed catches and logging?
Does the data deletion API properly cascade across consent_records, template_audit_trail, and outbound_messages for the given customer_phone?
Does ComplianceHelper mask TC kimlik and phone numbers consistently in all display contexts without affecting DB storage?

intentional_exclusions: Gercek 3rd party API implementation (Q credentials hazir olunca baglanir)
Knowledge Service training data export for AI personalization (mevcut API yeterli)
Outbound message queue refactor (mevcut MessageSenderService yeterli)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All try-catch blocks include typed catches with logging and INV-xxx error codes. Mock providers log warnings on simulated failures. Consent check failure blocks message send (fail-safe). AI personalization failure falls back to non-personalized template with warning.
